story_title: How AI Agents Are Transforming Complex Work
why_this_story: OpenAI research highlights a fundamental shift in how AI is utilized, moving from single-turn chat responses to autonomous multi-step agent workflows across professional roles.
viral_angle: AI is no longer just answering your questions—it is executing long multi-step tasks autonomously.
story_sentence: Everyone thinks AI is just a faster chatbot, but OpenAI research shows agents are taking over end-to-end multi-step work.

caption:
AI is moving past single chat responses. A new research paper from OpenAI shows how AI agents are transforming work by handling complex, multi-step tasks across roles.

Here is how the shift from assistant to delegate is changing productivity. 👇
